items.escena: A clay story ribbon unrolled flat on a table with a single fat translucent clay bubble floating above it, tied to the ribbon by three thin clay threads
Three chunky clay event figures lined up along a clay ribbon on the ground: a pot spilling coins, an empty chair and a small suitcase
A clay column standing tall at the centre of a small clay platform, holding up a single wide clay slab
Two slim clay props leaning in from the sides to hold up a wide clay slab, a thicker column already under its centre
A clay page lying flat with a soft raised shape showing through it from underneath, nothing drawn on the surface
The same small clay key appearing three times along a clay ribbon, at the start, the middle and the end
A ring of six small clay figures sitting around a low fire on a village doorstep, one telling and the rest listening
Two clay storybooks standing apart with completely different covers, joined above by one shared translucent clay bubble
